title: Prof K Vidyullatha Reddy appointed Vice-Chancellor of NLUO
description: Professor K Vidyullatha Reddy has been appointed as the Vice Chancellor of National Law University Odisha (NLUO).The appointment was announced by the National Academy of Legal Studies and Research (NALSAR) University of Law, Hyderabad, with which Prof. Reddy was associated for twenty-six years.Before this appointment, Prof. Reddy served as Registrar of NALSAR, a role she took on in January 2023.
